newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Italian flagship still stuck off Albanian port.
newsitem.headline: Italian flagship still stuck off Albanian port.

text.p: An international security force's Italian flagship, which ran aground off the rebel-held Albanian port of Vlore in stormy seas, was stuck on a sandbank for a second day early on Wednesday, witnesses said.
They said four tugs were tied to the cruiser Vittorio Veneto, which lay 500 metres (yards) offshore.
On Tuesday, the tugs vainly struggled in bad weather to pull it free.

The Vittorio Veneto is the flagship of an Italian-led force trying to protect aid deliveries to the Albania's poor after an armed insurrection prompted by failed investment schemes. About 160 Italian troops disembarked from Italian warships on Monday.
